newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial makes $138 mln acquisition.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial makes $138 mln acquisition.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Thursday that it had acquired a 39-property portfolio of 2.7 million square feet based in Long Island and New Jersey from Lazarus Burman for $138.8 million.
The company said the deal is believed to be the largest industrial REIT acquisition on the East Coast.

"The acquisition expands First Industrial's portfolio to more than 35 million square feet in 17 major U.S. markets and creates a strategic platform for additional expansion in the Northeast," the company said in a release.

The deal consisted of $86.4 million cash, assumption of $4.5 million permanent fixed-rate debt and the issuance of 1.6 million limited partnership units in First Industrial's subsidiary, First Industrial LP, the company said.
Additionally, it said it has obtained options to acquire five more properties and the right to acquire 13.5 acres of land for future development.
